summary.text: Bonnie Cullison is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates for District 19 in Montgomery County, first elected in 2010 and a member of the House since 2011. Her official page lists her as Vice Chair of the Health Committee.

paragraphs.text: Cullison's official page says she was born in St. Mary's County, Maryland, in 1954.
It lists a B.S. in speech and hearing sciences from the University of Maryland, College Park in 1976 and an M.A. in speech pathology in 1978.
It says she was a speech-language pathologist in St. Mary's County Public Schools from 1978 to 1981 and a special education teacher in Montgomery County Public Schools from 1981 to 2000.
The page lists her as Chair of the Insurance Subcommittee of the Health Committee and a member of the Rules and Executive Nominations Committee.
It also lists her as House Chair of the Joint Committee on Legislative Ethics and a former president of the Montgomery County Education Association.
